name: Bipolar transistors
summary: Bipolar transistors: small-signal NPN and PNP types and power transistors for switching and amplifying.
uses: Switching relays, LEDs and small motors
Replacing failed parts in old gear
identify: Three-legged parts: small black TO-92s, TO-220s with a metal tab, or round TO-3 metal cans, marked 2N3904, BC547, TIP120, 13003 and similar. Power types sit on heatsinks in amplifiers, chargers and older power supplies.
test: On diode mode, an NPN reads about 0.5–0.7V from base to emitter and base to collector, and open the other way. Collector to emitter should be open both ways.
